about: Converted from the FlightGear A-10 by scripts/a10/convert-ac3d.mjs. Positions in metres; aircraft files in the BODY frame (+X right wing, +Y up, −Z nose, origin = reference point R); stores in their own BODY-aligned frame with the origin at the top of the suspension lugs.

source.licence: GPL-2.0-or-later (package COPYING: GPL version 2; some files say "or later")

frame.originNote: R = 25 % of the model wing mean aerodynamic chord, on the centreline, 0.30 m above the FlightGear reference line

hud.source: Models/Cockpit/detail-cpt.ac object hud-screen (aft face of CPT-hud-screen)

gear.note: gear down, struts uncompressed; centre = wheel centre

gbu12.label: GBU-12 Paveway II (Mk 82 body + kit built in code)

lau117.label: LAU-117 single-rail Maverick launcher (built in code)
